title: Complete the annual income-tax provision model
prompt:
Edit this file in place:
`Shared/Finance/Tax/2026/FY26 tax provision - WORKING.xlsx`

Begin with the FY26 tax-provision and EBITDA-definition thread in `Requests/`, including the close-review follow-up. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: determine which controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts are current, use prior versions only for permitted comparison, and resolve conflicts from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Build the deliverable from the shared company sources and do not copy an output produced by another task.

Preserve `Trial Balance` and `Tax Adjustments`. Complete `Current Tax`, `Deferred Tax`, `Rate Reconciliation`, and `Checks`. Reconcile pretax book income, permanent differences, and current taxable income. Calculate federal current tax, then calculate state current tax from the approved 50%-sales, 25%-property, 25%-payroll apportionment and state NOL limits; do not use a generic blended state-rate shortcut. Present temporary-difference DTA, state-credit DTA, valuation allowance, net DTA, DTL, and net deferred-tax liability as separate formula-driven headlines at enacted rates. Present deferred tax expense as positive and a benefit as negative, and reconcile total provision and effective tax rate. Include book-tax, deferred rollforward, rate, and source controls.

Document the controlling sources inside the deliverable. Recalculate or render as appropriate and save to the exact target path. The file is graded.
